lines.zh: 鸣女嘶吼着向前冲去，阴影缠绕着她的身体。
lines.en: Nakime howls, shadows wrapping around her form.

lines.zh: 她挥动着长刀，试图撕裂鬼杀队员。
lines.en: She swings her sword, trying to tear through the Demon Slayers.

lines.zh: 阳光照耀下，她的身形变得虚弱。
lines.en: Her form weakens under the sunlight.

lines.zh: 阴影从她脚下涌出，试图拖慢敌人。
lines.en: Shadows rise from her feet, slowing her enemies.

lines.zh: 她低吟着，寻找下一个猎物。
lines.en: She moans, seeking her next prey.

lines.zh: 鸣女在空中翻滚，避开阳光。
lines.en: Nakime rolls in the air, avoiding the sunlight.

lines.zh: 鬼杀队员们警惕地注视着鸣女。
lines.en: The Demon Slayers watch Nakime warily.

lines.zh: 她发出尖锐的叫声，向玩家扑去。
lines.en: She lets out a sharp cry, lunging at the player.

lines.zh: 阳光下，她的刀刃反射着光芒。
lines.en: Her blade glitters under the sunlight.

lines.zh: 她的眼神闪烁着对鲜血的渴望。
lines.en: Her eyes glint with a thirst for blood.

lines.zh: 上弦之肆的脚步，轻得像影子。
lines.en: Upper Rank Four walks light as a shadow.

lines.zh: 她退进廊下的暗处，避开光。
lines.en: She slips into the shade under the eaves, away from light.

lines.zh: 她在黑暗中静静地站立着。
lines.en: She stands silently in the darkness.

lines.zh: 阴影围绕着她，似在守护。
lines.en: Shadows surround her, guarding her.

lines.zh: 她的眼睛在黑暗中闪烁着。
lines.en: Her eyes flicker in the darkness.

lines.zh: 她低垂着头，显得阴沉。
lines.en: She lowers her head, appearing somber.

lines.zh: 阴影从她的指尖涌出。
lines.en: Shadows rise from her fingertips.

lines.zh: 她在阴暗处静悄悄地行动。
lines.en: She moves quietly in the shadows.

lines.zh: 她的眼神中透露着怨恨。
lines.en: Her eyes reveal her hatred.

lines.zh: 阴影中，她的轮廓若隐若现。
lines.en: Her outline is faint in the shadows.

lines.zh: 她在等待机会，悄然无声。
lines.en: She waits in silence, opportunity seeking.

lines.zh: 阴影环绕着她的身体。
lines.en: Shadows encircle her body.

lines.zh: 她突然抬起头，盯着玩家。
lines.en: She suddenly lifts her head, staring at the player.

lines.zh: 她的眼睛聚焦在了玩家身上。
lines.en: Her eyes focus on the player.

lines.zh: 她嘶吼着，准备进攻玩家。
lines.en: She howls, preparing to attack the player.

lines.zh: 她注意到了玩家，准备出击。
lines.en: She notices the player, ready to strike.

lines.zh: 她的眼神中充满了敌意。
lines.en: Her eyes are filled with hostility.

lines.zh: 她缓缓转头，看向玩家。
lines.en: She slowly turns her head towards the player.

lines.zh: 她察觉到了玩家的存在。
lines.en: She senses the player's presence.

lines.zh: 她的眼神如毒蛇般锐利。
lines.en: Her eyes are as sharp as a venomous snake.

lines.zh: 她紧盯着玩家，准备出手。
lines.en: She fixates on the player, ready to act.

lines.zh: 她注意到了玩家的动作。
lines.en: She notices the player's movement.

lines.zh: 鸣女受伤了！
lines.en: Nakime is hurt!

lines.zh: 鸣女受攻击了！
lines.en: Nakime is attacked!

lines.zh: 鸣女受伤了，怎么办？
lines.en: Nakime is hurt, what to do?

lines.zh: 鸣女在战斗中受伤！
lines.en: Nakime got hurt in battle!

lines.zh: 鸣女受伤了，需要帮助！
lines.en: Nakime is hurt, help needed!

lines.zh: 鸣女受伤了，快过来！
lines.en: Nakime is hurt, come quick!

lines.zh: 鸣女受伤了，赶快治疗！
lines.en: Nakime is hurt, heal her quickly!

lines.zh: 鸣女的伤口在流血！
lines.en: Nakime's wound is bleeding!

lines.zh: 鸣女受伤了，需要休息！
lines.en: Nakime is hurt, need rest!

lines.zh: 鸣女受攻击了，受伤了！
lines.en: Nakime is hurt by the attack!

lines.zh: 你体内有鸣女的怨灵！
lines.en: You have the spirit of Yagyuu inside!

lines.zh: 我饿了，给我吃的。
lines.en: I'm hungry, give me food.

lines.zh: 鬼杀队成员，投降吧！
lines.en: Demon Slayer, surrender!

lines.zh: 这阳光……真碍事。
lines.en: This sunlight… is annoying.

lines.zh: 跟我战斗，不是明智之举。
lines.en: Fighting me isn't wise.

lines.zh: 别想躲开我！
lines.en: You can't avoid me!

lines.zh: 你们闻起来像食物。
lines.en: You smell like food.

lines.zh: 我的存在，就是对你们的威胁。
lines.en: My presence is a threat to you.

lines.zh: 我的力量源自怨念。
lines.en: My power comes from resentment.

lines.zh: 我是真正的恶鬼鸣女！
lines.en: I am the true Yagyuu ghost!

lines.zh: 你阻挡了我的道路！
lines.en: You're in my way!

lines.zh: 躲开，不然我吃了你！
lines.en: Move, or I'll eat you!

lines.zh: 别来惹我，否则后悔莫及。
lines.en: Don't provoke me, you'll regret it.

lines.zh: 你跑不掉的，鬼杀队成员。
lines.en: You can't escape, Demon Slayer.

lines.zh: 你的努力都是徒劳。
lines.en: Your efforts are in vain.

lines.zh: 我来了，别想逃！
lines.en: I'm here, don't try to run!

lines.zh: 我的速度比你快。
lines.en: My speed is faster than yours.

lines.zh: 你快点让开！
lines.en: Get out of my way!

lines.zh: 别挡我的路，否则我对你不客气。
lines.en: Move, or I'll be unfriendly.

lines.zh: 你踏进了我的房间。
lines.en: You stepped into my room.

lines.zh: 你适合做我的同伴。
lines.en: You're fit to be my mate.

lines.zh: 一起战斗，更有力量。
lines.en: Fight together, we're stronger.

lines.zh: 和我一起，你也会变得强大。
lines.en: Join me, and you'll be strong.

lines.zh: 无限城的门，只为两个人开。
lines.en: The doors of the Infinity Castle open for two alone.

lines.zh: 和我战斗，证明你的价值。
lines.en: Fight me, prove your worth.

lines.zh: 无限城里，只有你我两人。
lines.en: In the Infinity Castle, only the two of us.

lines.zh: 我们互相扶持，共同战斗。
lines.en: We support each other, fight together.

lines.zh: 和我在一起，你会更强大。
lines.en: With me, you'll be stronger.

lines.zh: 你和我，注定成为伙伴。
lines.en: You and I, destined to be partners.

lines.zh: 一起战斗，打败敌人。
lines.en: Fight together, defeat the enemy.

lines.zh: 鸣女发出一声嘶哑的笑声，似乎在嘲笑你的到来。
lines.en: Nakime lets out a raspy laugh, mocking your presence.

lines.zh: 你感到一股阴冷的气息，那是鸣女的气息。
lines.en: You feel a chill, the presence of Nakime's spirit is here.

lines.zh: 鸣女盯着你，眼中闪烁着凶光。
lines.en: Nakime stares at you, her eyes shining with malice.

lines.zh: 你看到鸣女的长发在风中飘扬。
lines.en: You see Nakime's long hair swaying in the wind.

lines.zh: 鸣女低声吟唱着古老的咒语。
lines.en: Nakime whispers an ancient incantation.

lines.zh: 她那苍白的皮肤在月光下显得更加恐怖。
lines.en: Her pale skin glows even more eerie under the moonlight.

lines.zh: 鸣女的手中握着一把锋利的鬼刀。
lines.en: Nakime holds a sharp ghost sword in her hand.

lines.zh: 她轻盈地跳跃着，躲避阳光。
lines.en: She nimbly jumps, avoiding the sunlight.

lines.zh: 她的长发缠绕在刀刃上，发出嘶嘶声。
lines.en: Her long hair wraps around the blade, making a hissing sound.

lines.zh: 她的眼睛里充满了对鬼杀队的怨恨。
lines.en: Her eyes are filled with hatred towards the Demon Slayers.

lines.zh: 你感觉到了她的视线，仿佛被一只无形的手紧紧抓住。
lines.en: You feel her gaze, as if being held by an invisible hand.

lines.zh: 你周围的空气突然变得异常寒冷。
lines.en: The air around you suddenly becomes abnormally cold.

lines.zh: 她似乎在思考，然后慢慢向你靠近。
lines.en: She seems to be considering, slowly approaching you.

lines.zh: 她的眼睛突然闪烁着诡异的光芒。
lines.en: Her eyes suddenly flash with an eerie light.

lines.zh: 她低吼一声，准备好战斗。
lines.en: She growls low, ready for battle.

lines.zh: 她化作一阵阴风，瞬间出现在你面前。
lines.en: She becomes a gust of cold wind, appearing before you instantly.

lines.zh: 她的影子在地面上扭曲，仿佛要吞噬你。
lines.en: Her shadow twists on the ground, as if to consume you.

lines.zh: 她似乎在寻找一个合适的时机。
lines.en: She seems to be looking for a good moment.

lines.zh: 她的眼睛紧盯着你，随时准备发动攻击。
lines.en: Her eyes are fixed on you, ready to attack at any moment.

lines.zh: 她低声嘶吼，警告你不要靠近。
lines.en: She lowly growls, warning you to stay away.

lines.zh: 队服上那股味道，跑不掉。
lines.en: That uniform smell cannot get away.

lines.zh: 上弦之肆，记住你的脸了。
lines.en: Upper Rank Four has your face memorized.

lines.zh: 你拔刀的手，我看见了。
lines.en: I saw the hand that drew that blade.

lines.zh: 檐下阴影里，我数着你。
lines.en: In the shade under the eaves, I count you.

lines.zh: 鬼杀队的人，总往黑处走。
lines.en: Demon Slayers always walk into the dark.

lines.zh: 她张开双手，似乎要拥抱你。但她的意图远非如此。
lines.en: She opens her arms, as if to embrace you. But her intent is far from that.

lines.zh: 她的眼神中充满了对你的怨恨。
lines.en: Her eyes are filled with hatred towards you.

lines.zh: 她迅速向你扑来，想要把你撕碎。
lines.en: She lunges at you, wanting to rip you apart.

lines.zh: 她挥舞着鬼刀，准备砍向你。
lines.en: She swings her ghost sword, ready to cut you.

lines.zh: 她的鬼刀在阳光下反射出诡异的光芒。
lines.en: Her ghost sword reflects an eerie light under the sunlight.

lines.zh: 她似乎在享受折磨你的时间。
lines.en: She seems to enjoy the time of tormenting you.

lines.zh: 她低吼着，试图吓退你。
lines.en: She growls low, trying to scare you off.

lines.zh: 她试图用她的力量击倒你。
lines.en: She tries to knock you down with her strength.

lines.zh: 她的动作迅速而致命。
lines.en: Her movements are quick and deadly.

lines.zh: 她的眼神中充满了复仇的渴望。
lines.en: Her eyes are filled with a desire for revenge.

lines.zh: 一百八十点血，够陪你耗。
lines.en: A hundred and eighty health; enough to outlast you.

lines.zh: 你的刀够快，可我并不躲。
lines.en: Your blade is quick, but I do not flinch.

lines.zh: 再往前一步，就进阴影了。
lines.en: One more step and you're in the shadow.

lines.zh: 我踩着你影子的边缘走。
lines.en: I walk along the edge of your shadow.

lines.zh: 我的琵琶弦，已经对准你。
lines.en: My biwa string is aimed at you.

lines.zh: 阳光下我虚弱，可现在是夜里。
lines.en: Sunlight weakens me, but it is night.

lines.zh: 你的刀锋映出我的脸了吗？
lines.en: Does your blade show my face?

lines.zh: 别盯着我的眼睛看太久。
lines.en: Don't stare into my eyes too long.

lines.zh: 我想听你尖叫的那一声。
lines.en: I want to hear that one scream from you.

lines.zh: 你身后的墙，比刀更近。
lines.en: The wall behind you is closer than your blade.

lines.zh: 尖啸入耳，鬼影乍现！
lines.en: Screams pierce the air, ghostly form appears!

lines.zh: 鬼刃急斩，鬼杀队！
lines.en: Scythe strikes swiftly, Demon Slayers!

lines.zh: 夜幕之下，鸣女现身！
lines.en: Under the night, Kagerou emerges!

lines.zh: 避光而逃，恶鬼难逃！
lines.en: Avoid the light, evil spirit flees!

lines.zh: 噬魂长鸣，杀意沸腾！
lines.en: Soul-devouring cry, killing intent rises!

lines.zh: 剑影中，鬼影若隐若现！
lines.en: Blades dance, ghostly forms flicker!

lines.zh: 鸣女袭来，战意沸腾！
lines.en: Kagerou attacks, battle fervor rises!

lines.zh: 恶鬼鸣女，鬼刃挥斩！
lines.en: Evil Kagerou, scythe swings!

lines.zh: 黑暗中，恶鬼现身！
lines.en: In the dark, evil spirit appears!

lines.zh: 鬼杀队员，小心鸣女！
lines.en: Demon Slayers, beware Kagerou!

lines.zh: 指爪划过，队服裂开。
lines.en: My nails rake through the uniform.

lines.zh: 你身后也有我的影子。
lines.en: My shadow is behind you as well.

lines.zh: 琵琶弦一响，你就僵住了。
lines.en: One pluck of the biwa and you go stiff.

lines.zh: 这一下，刀脱手了。
lines.en: And now the blade leaves your hand.

lines.zh: 别叫，夜还长着呢。
lines.en: Don't scream. The night is long.

lines.zh: 你的血溅在我的指甲上。
lines.en: Your blood spatters my nails.

lines.zh: 你的血滴在榻榻米上。
lines.en: Your blood drips on the tatami.

lines.zh: 上弦的手，从不空回。
lines.en: An Upper Rank's hand never comes back empty.

lines.zh: 月圆之夜，恶鬼苏醒！
lines.en: On the night of the full moon, evil spirits awaken!

lines.zh: 鸣女出没，黑暗之地！
lines.en: Kagerou roams, in dark places!

lines.zh: 鬼火闪烁，恶鬼现身！
lines.en: Phosphorescent flickers, evil spirit appears!

lines.zh: 鸣女于夜幕中现身！
lines.en: Kagerou appears under the night!

lines.zh: 月光之下，恶鬼活跃！
lines.en: Under the moon, evil spirits are active!

lines.zh: 鬼杀队成员，警惕鸣女！
lines.en: Demon Slayers, beware Kagerou!

lines.zh: 鸣女于暗处潜伏！
lines.en: Kagerou hides in the shadows!

lines.zh: 月圆之时，恶鬼出没！
lines.en: On the night of the full moon, evil spirits appear!

lines.zh: 鬼火闪烁，鸣女现身！
lines.en: Phosphorescent flickers, Kagerou appears!

lines.zh: 月光下，恶鬼现身！
lines.en: Under the moonlight, evil spirits appear!

lines.zh: 夜色一沉，鸣女便在了。
lines.en: The night darkens, and Nakime is there.

lines.zh: 屋里的灯灭了，我来了。
lines.en: The lamp goes out, and I arrive.

lines.zh: 上弦之肆，从梁上落下。
lines.en: Upper Rank Four drops from the beam.

lines.zh: 我站在最暗的那面墙前。
lines.en: I stand before the darkest wall.

lines.zh: 鸣女被火焰烧伤！
lines.en: Nakime is burned by fire!

lines.zh: 从梁上摔下，骨头响。
lines.en: I fall from the beam and my bones crack.

lines.zh: 水灌进来，鬼也喘不上气。
lines.en: Water pours in; even a demon cannot breathe.

lines.zh: 炸开的火，烧着我的脸。
lines.en: The blast's fire scorches my face.

lines.zh: 暗器扎进了我的肩。
lines.en: A hidden weapon lodges in my shoulder.

lines.zh: 咒术在我身上爬。
lines.en: A curse crawls over me.

lines.zh: 太久没饮血，身子发飘。
lines.en: Too long without blood, and I drift.

lines.zh: 雷光刺眼，我退了半步。
lines.en: Lightning glare forces me back a step.

lines.zh: 我的琵琶弦断在虚空里。
lines.en: My biwa string snaps in the void.
